notes: Normalized from a dark, illustration-led marketing page; trusts the screenshots over the raw profile. The raw 'color' top entry rgb(247,247,248) is FOREGROUND text (#f7f7f8), not bg — the true page bg is a very dark plum-black #0d0c14 with #13111c section panels (raw under-samples large painterly hero/footer images, so it skews toward text colors). Surfaces are NOT a single neutral: cool blue-grey panels (#1b2132) for product/feature canvases, a warm plum tint (#1f132a) for the promo bar, and a desaturated teal-green (#1f2b2e) for the testimonial band — each section gets a faintly tinted dark surface. Accent purple #a667e4 is used sparingly for inline links, focus glow, and the primary button fill which is a deeper #553f83; border purple #a05fcf appears on focus. Icon accents are a fixed semantic-ish trio (green/orange/pink) used decoratively per feature row, not as status colors. Borders are a near-invisible #33323e hairline (raw's most-frequent border, count 1220) plus white-alpha hairlines on glass chips. Type is a deliberate serif+sans pairing: IBM Plex Serif for all display/section headlines, Inter for body/labels/UI, mono for tiny system labels. Display top size ~54px (raw 54px once; line-height 60.48/65px); body 16px/26px. Radius clusters at 8px (cards) and 9999px (pills); 28px is the large hero-card radius on mobile. Shadows are inset hairline rings only — no drop shadows on this dark canvas. Collapsed one-off px line-heights (28.8, 22.75, 60.48) into a leading ramp.
